golf_swing.insufficient_shoulder_turn.what: Limited shoulder rotation at the top of your backswing.
golf_swing.insufficient_shoulder_turn.why: Without enough separation between shoulders and hips at the top, you lose the stored rotational power a full backswing turn generates.
golf_swing.insufficient_shoulder_turn.whatToChange: Turn your shoulders further away from the target before starting the downswing.
golf_swing.insufficient_shoulder_turn.cue: Turn your back fully to the target.
golf_swing.insufficient_shoulder_turn.drill: Cross-arm turn drill: cross your arms over your chest holding a club and practice rotating your shoulders 90° while keeping your hips more stable.
